canonical_situation: A delivery package has no usable normal barcode or only a 00 barcode
normalized_description: The driver cannot scan the expected package barcode and must determine whether the special 00 key-entry contingency applies or the package must return for relabeling.
authoritative_rule: A package with no barcode is returned to the station for a replacement barcode. A 00 barcode should have a 2D or 96 primary barcode, which is scanned instead. If the 2D barcode cannot be scanned, the 20-digit 00 number may be entered using SHIFT + Scan. If no 2D or 96 barcode is present, return the package for a replacement barcode.

Scan the 2D or 96 barcode if present and usable.

If no barcode exists, or a 00 barcode has no accompanying 2D or 96 barcode, retain the package and return it to the station for a replacement barcode.

canonical_situation: Completing or failing an Adult Signature Required delivery
normalized_description: An ASR delivery requires an eligible adult, valid government ID, age verification, and an in-person signature, with distinct branches for ID refusal and scan failure.
authoritative_rule: ASR requires an in-person signature at the labeled address from someone age 21 or older whose valid government ID is checked. If the recipient refuses to provide ID, use Code 006, add the delivery notation, and return the package to the station. If valid ID is presented but its barcode cannot be read or scanning is declined after the scan attempt, the limited manual DOB and visual-verification path may be used. If no eligible signer is available, use Code 007 residential or Code 004 non-residential and do not leave the package.
applicability: FORGE identifies the package as Adult Signature Required
conditions: The signer is at least 21 and at the labeled address
A valid government-issued ID is presented and checked
Manual DOB entry is allowed only after a scan attempt when valid ID was presented but cannot be scanned or scanning is declined
exceptions: Alcohol adds the no-visible-intoxication rule and remains subject to all ASR requirements

canonical_situation: Delivering an alcohol package
normalized_description: An alcohol package requires the ASR path plus alcohol-specific legal restrictions.
authoritative_rule: Alcohol requires acceptable photo ID regardless of apparent age, age 21 or older, no visible intoxication, and an in-person signature at the labeled address. Never driver release, indirectly deliver, or use a signed door tag as release authorization. If no eligible signer is available, use Code 007 residential or Code 004 non-residential. If the recipient refuses to provide ID, use Code 006, add delivery notation, and return the package to the station.
applicability: The package displays the unique alcohol label as a separate label, part of the shipping label, or an imprint on the carton
conditions: Acceptable photo ID is presented
Recipient is age 21 or older
Recipient is not visibly intoxicated
In-person signature is collected at the labeled address
exceptions: A valid ID presented but unscannable after an attempted scan may use the limited ASR manual-verification contingency

required_procedure.action: Identify the alcohol label and use the ASR delivery path.
Check acceptable photo ID, confirm age 21 or older and no visible intoxication, and obtain the in-person signature at the labeled address.
If no eligible signer is available, use Code 007 for residential or Code 004 for non-residential.
If ID is refused, use Code 006 and the delivery notation; never leave the package.

required_documentation: ID verification and adult signature when delivered
Code 006 and delivery notation for ID refusal
Code 007 residential or Code 004 non-residential when no eligible signer is available
Door tag and prompted attempt photo when unsuccessful
prohibited_actions: Do not driver release, indirectly deliver, use a signed door tag for release, or deliver to a visibly intoxicated person.
clarification_requirements: Is an eligible person age 21 or older present with acceptable photo ID and no visible intoxication?
If delivery cannot be completed, is the stop residential or non-residential?

canonical_situation: Completing, scanning, and placing a Shipment Status Door Tag
normalized_description: The driver must complete and scan the door tag, place it at the correct entrance, and capture the attempt photo when prompted.
authoritative_rule: For a delivery attempt requiring a door tag, mark the applicable reason, scan the tag barcode to link it to the tracking ID, secure it to the main/front entrance door, and capture the prompted attempt photo. Do not place it on a mailbox, call box, perimeter fence, gate, or the package itself.
applicability: A delivery or indirect-delivery workflow requires a Shipment Status Door Tag
conditions: The tag is completed for the actual situation
The barcode is scanned
The tag is placed at the main entrance used for in-person deliveries
exceptions: For DSR or ASR, the signature option may be torn off before placement
Photography-restricted locations use the Restricted Location path

required_procedure.action: Mark the applicable reason or recipient note on the door tag.
Scan the door tag barcode.
Secure the tag to the main/front entrance door.
Capture the prompted attempt photo.

prohibited_actions: Do not leave the tag on a mailbox, call box, perimeter fence, gate, or the package itself.

canonical_situation: Processing a Shipment Release Authorization for ISR
normalized_description: The driver must distinguish barcoded and non-barcoded SRA forms and use the matching FORGE path.
authoritative_rule: An SRA authorizes release of an ISR shipment. A barcoded SRA uses ALT, Shipment Release Auth, and the SRA barcode. A non-barcoded SRA uses ALT, Shipment Status Tag, a door tag barcode marked On File, and both forms are returned at check-in.
applicability: The shipment is ISR
The recipient supplied a signed SRA form
conditions: The barcode status of the SRA controls the scanner workflow
exceptions: Electronic Signature Received is a separate on-road intercept path

required_procedure.action: Check whether the SRA has a barcode.
Choose ALT and the matching SRA option.
Scan the SRA barcode, or scan a door tag marked On File for a non-barcoded SRA.
Enter the recipient initial and last name and turn in the required form or forms at check-in.

required_documentation: Scanned SRA barcode or door tag marked On File
SRA returned at check-in; non-barcoded path also returns the door tag
prohibited_actions: Do not use SRA authorization for DSR, ASR, alcohol, or appointment delivery.
clarification_requirements: Does the SRA form have a barcode?

canonical_situation: Capturing delivery or attempted-delivery proof photographs
normalized_description: The driver must capture the correct photo for a delivered package or an unsuccessful attempt while avoiding people and sensitive information.
authoritative_rule: A delivery PPOD should show the package in its release location with enough surroundings to recognize placement. An attempt PPODA should show the door tag at the primary entrance with enough surroundings to recognize the location, without people, body parts, or residential sensitive information. Photography-restricted locations use the Restricted Location path.
applicability: FORGE prompts for Photo at Delivery, Photo at Attempted Delivery, or business PPOD
conditions: The image is clear and corresponds to the actual delivery or attempt location
exceptions: Met Customer residential delivery is excluded from ordinary residential driver-release PPOD
Photography-restricted areas use the Restricted Location screen

required_procedure.action: Capture the package in its release location, or the door tag and entrance for an attempt.
Include enough surroundings to recognize the location.
Exclude people, body parts, and residential sensitive information from attempt photos.
Review the image and tap DONE.

prohibited_actions: Do not use a distant, blurry, vehicle, or people-focused image.
Do not include residential house or apartment numbers or license plates in an attempt photo.
clarification_requirements: Is this a completed delivery photo or an unsuccessful-attempt photo?

normalized_description: The driver has completed three unsuccessful attempts and needs the next supported disposition.
authoritative_rule: After three unsuccessful delivery attempts, give the package to QA so the recipient can be contacted. Three attempts do not by themselves rule out a further attempt.
applicability: Three unsuccessful delivery attempts are already documented
exceptions: A further attempt may still be made under the applicable station process

prohibited_actions: Do not state that a fourth attempt is automatically prohibited or automatically required.
